title: Necrotizing granuloma: MedlinePlus Medical Encyclopedia
content: Necrotizing granuloma A granuloma is a clump of cells that forms when the immune system tries to fight off a harmful substance but cannot remove it from the body. A necrotizing granuloma is an area of inflammation in which tissue has died. Necrotizing means dying or decaying. Tuberculosis and granulomatosis with polyangiitis are conditions that cause necrotizing granulomas. Alternative Names Granuloma References Jones KD, Urisman A. Histopathologic approach to the surgical lung biopsy in interstitial lung disease. In: Collard HR, Richeldi L, eds. Interstitial Lung Disease. Philadelphia, PA: Elsevier; 2018:chap 12.
